attributes.board_name: Mississippi State Board of Examiners for Licensed Professional Counselors

rules.accepted_credit_types: Preapproved: CE approved by ACA, AMHCA, Mississippi Counseling Association, MLPCA (with MCA approval), AAMFT, NBCC; other CE reviewed at renewal; regionally accredited coursework (1 semester hr = 15 h); NBCC-numbered home study
rules.audit_note: Mandatory random audit of 10% of licensees at renewal; keep records 2 years after the renewal year.

topics.who: Professional ethics or legal issues in counseling
Certificate of completion of the Mississippi Jurisprudence exam (Mississippi Legal and Ethical Responsibilities Examination) submitted with renewal
Board-qualified supervisors: at least 1 hour per year

rules.notes: Renewal period July 1 - June 30 every 2 years; CE log submitted with renewal by June 30. CE accrues only after license issue date. Board website lpc.ms.gov returned 503 (parked page) to our checker.
rules.legal_basis: Miss. Admin. Code Title 30, Part 2201, Rules 6.1-6.2

topics.who: Professional ethics or legal issues in counseling

rules.notes: Provisional LPCs renew yearly (July 1 - June 30) and submit a CE log.
rules.legal_basis: Miss. Admin. Code Title 30, Part 2201, Rule 6.1
